device.modelDescription: Calls main-checked over a hop and reports what came back (test/sandbox/41).

actionList.name: hop
actionList.description: Calls main-checked with the given action and input; reports the result or the rejection's code.

actionList.name: ping
actionList.description: Answers at once: another module's call during a flood of main-checked's.

actionList.name: hopDigest
actionList.description: main-checked's big over a hop, as its length and sha256 (test/sandbox/42).

actionList.name: hopOdd
actionList.description: main-checked's odd or forge over a hop: what arrived, or the rejection's code (test/sandbox/42).
